details: A corner of a contained cube must be distinguished on every cube coordinate.
name: Maximum Teaching Set Size / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
proof: For a contained $d$-cube, choose any corner.  For each of the $d$ cube coordinates there is a neighbouring concept differing only there, so every teaching set for that corner must include all $d$ coordinates.  Thus the maximum teaching-set size is at least $d$.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
